title: Use a character sheet/image as a reference input in Seedance 2 to guide the…
content: Use a character sheet/image as a reference input in Seedance 2 to guide the generated video toward a specific character’s look and style.
tips: Use a character sheet/image as a reference input in Seedance 2 to guide the generated video toward a specific character’s look and style.

es.content:
Utiliza una hoja de personaje/imagen como referencia de entrada en Seedance 2 para guiar el video generado hacia la apariencia y estilo específicos de un personaje.

--- TWEET CITADO ---
